Dana (AE): Quick handoff: SolaceRx closed today. Committed Dedicated 4GPU + hosted fallback. Key asks: Okta SCIM, custom SAML attrs (team, role), 2yr audit retention, optional VPC peering. Target go-live in ~6 weeks.
Priya (CSM): thanks Dana. Please paste contract link and pilot notes. I'll own kickoff and acceptance criteria.
Dana (AE): contract https://redwood.example/contract/SOLACE-2026. Pilot: steady 90 rps, p95 gen ~200ms, used streaming + rerank. Costs roughly inline.
Dana (AE): Risks: 1) legal insist on 2yr logs 2) custom SAML attrs may need mapping work 3) tight timeline for peering if they opt in.
Priya (CSM): Mei, can you validate SCIM + SAML attribute mapping feasibility on Dedicated? Also confirm whether we can export logs encrypted to customer S3 for 2yrs.
Mei (SRE): I can run attribute mapping in staging. Need Okta metadata or admin test tenant. Logs: export to S3 is supported but need to confirm KMS and retention lifecycle; likely config-only. ETA 48-72h.
Ravi (Support): I'll open two tickets: one for SSO/SCIM validation, one for audit export. Will include pilot logs and link to this thread.
Priya (CSM): Owners/action items: - Priya: kickoff, acceptance criteria doc - Mei: SCIM/SAML report + log export options by +72h - Ravi: create tickets and initial triage by EOD - Dana: share customer engineering contacts and preferred go-live window
Mei (SRE): note: if custom SAML attrs require new claim mapping, may need a small runtime config change -> potential 3-5 business day delay.
Ravi (Support): Tickets created: SUP-9333 (SolaceRx SSO/SCIM) and SUP-9334 (SolaceRx audit export). Linked to eng-platform for potential infra work.
Priya (CSM): marking Renewal_Risk=medium due to legal retention ask. I'll add cost-transparency feedback (they wanted clearer per-route cost) to the product board once onboarding stabilizes.
Dana (AE): I'll send customer contacts and confirm whether they will request VPC peering.
Priya (CSM): scheduling kickoff week of May 16. Let's sync Wed 10am PT if that works. Ravi/Mei, flag any blockers earlier.
compliance-bot: reminder scheduled: "SolaceRx onboarding kickoff" Wed 10:00 PT (Priya, Mei, Ravi, Dana)
Priya (CSM): thanks all. Mei please post results here when ready so I can finalize acceptance criteria.
